plivo is a command-line interface for the Plivo REST API.

Credentials resolve in order:
  1. --profile flag
  2. active profile in ~/.plivo/config.toml
  3. PLIVO_AUTH_ID / PLIVO_AUTH_TOKEN env vars

Usage:
  plivo [command]

Available Commands:
  account     Inspect and update the active Plivo account
  agent       AI voice agents (coming soon)
  ask         Ask Plivo's AI assistant (streams the answer as it comes)
  auth        Manage credential profiles (list / use / remove / whoami)
  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  help        Help about any command
  login       Log in to Plivo (saves credentials securely to the OS keychain)
  logout      Log out a profile (deletes its entry + removes the auth_token from the OS keychain)
  lookup      Carrier + format lookup for an E.164 number (lookup.plivo.com)
  message     Send messages (SMS/MMS/WhatsApp); manage 10DLC, powerpacks, toll-free
  numbers     Manage account phone numbers
  support     List your past support escalations (filed via `plivo ask`)
  upgrade     Upgrade plivo to the latest release
  verify      Plivo Verify — OTP / phone-number verification sessions
  voice       Voice — calls, conferences, multiparty, recordings, endpoints

Flags:
      --all                auto-paginate through all pages
      --dry-run            print the HTTP request without sending
      --explain            explain what the command will do before executing
  -h, --help               help for plivo
      --log-level string   log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color           disable colored output
  -o, --output string      output format: table|json (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string     named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
  -q, --quiet              suppress non-data output
      --timeout int        request timeout in seconds (default 30)
  -y, --yes                skip confirmation prompts

Use "plivo [command] --help" for more information about a command.
